programmes.d: In 2004, Ruby, a college student witnesses a supernatural horror at a local sorority house where three women, known as The Takers, kill and drain the life out of her friends to preserve their youth and beauty.

When Trey's ex-girlfriend, Jada, unexpectedly shows up to his studio, she accuses him of dark secrets and being involved in a missing persons case. Their reunion quickly spirals into psychological warfare and violence.

When Malorie's sister, Monica, disappears, everyone around her tells her to grieve and move on. Determined to bring her justice, Malorie embarks on a search for the truth. But when she meets Tyriq, his motives may not be as pure as they seem.

Four women embark on a journey of self-discovery and resilience, bound by the unbreakable bonds of friendship. Through tears and laughter, heartache and triumph, they become closer while helping each other through some tough situations.

When sheltered college student Angel, the daughter of the police chief, falls for Romelle "Demon" Montez, the ruthless leader of the South Side Mob, they become star-crossed lovers. Their toxic romance spirals into a world of gang violence.

After Michael & Tiffany end their five-year relationship, they awaken to find they've switched bodies. Now they are forced to work together to live each other's lives, while doing all they can to make sure friends and coworkers don't suspect a thing.

When Danielle's family kicks her out for being rebellious, she takes refuge at her best friend Tomeka's house. Things quickly turn into a game of survival as Tomeka's mother comes up with a plan to solve her money issues.

Derek Dirt Roberts is the top lieutenant for Big Boss, a criminal mastermind who becomes the city's most powerful organized criminal. When the two grow apart, Dirt hatches an elaborate plan to leave the organization.
Events over the course of one traumatic night in Georgia unfold as the reckless Kennedy discovers her lovers darkest secrets.

A young married couple moves in a female childhood friend who the wife hasn't seen in years. Slowly the house guest starts seducing the ones around her and people start dying. Can anyone stop her before it's too late?

James is out of jail, and is looking for Darnell to get a piece of his lotto winnings, but Darnell feels differently. Now enemies they both find themselves fighting the battle to stay alive, but the death of a close friend changes everything.
